caseName: Bell v. Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Helen Bell, as Administratrix of George Bell, in Error v. Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Company
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: Mr. Alan D. Cole for plaintiff in error., Mr. E. L. Worthington, Mr. W. D. Cochran and Mr. LeWright Browning for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co. v. King, 222 U. S. 222; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668; Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co. v. Whitacre, 242 U. S. 169.
